notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
This update is the addition of new content and improvements to  the overall gameplay experience.

1. Adding ammo limiting 

2. Adding ammo collection from destroyed block

3. Adjusting the firing speed of weapons

4. Adjusting the firing frequency of the AI gun

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
Since the game's launch, we have been focusing on all your feedback and comments. Our small team have been working hard to fulfill your requests.

This update is the addition of new content and improvements to the overall gameplay experience.

1.Adding new weapons.

2.Adding “quick play” button, it’s match maker.

3.A playlist system cycling through the different arenas, loading from one arena to the next. You can choose random or loop.

4.Small improvements on the in-game scoreboard, such as player's title.

5.Various bug fixes, such as the "ESC" button does not respond, host cannot go back to main menu in the next turn.

6.Changing HUD and font.
